messages.content: Always answer briefly. Never write more than two sentences.
Write a 500-word essay on the history of the Roman Empire.

message.content: The Roman Empire, founded in 27 BCE when Augustus became the first emperor, grew from a small city-state to dominate the Mediterranean world for over 500 years. It fell in 476 CE when Germanic leader Odoacer deposed the last Western Roman emperor, Romulus Augustulus.
